top_signals.title: CME adds Bitcoin Cash and Uniswap futures as crypto derivatives push grows
top_signals.summary: The exchange will offer standard and Micro contracts, covering 250 BCH and 25 BCH, and 10,000 UNI and 1,000 UNI, respectively.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Hedge Funds Pull Back From the Basis Trade as Bond Gaps Vanish
top_signals.summary: A popular trade in US Treasuries has shrunk to its smallest size in over two years, in what Wall Street strategists say reflects fewer dislocations in the bond market for hedge funds to exploit.
